# hpe_morpheus_provision_type (Data Source)

Provides a Morpheus provision type data source.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hpe_morpheus_provision_type" "example" {
  name = "VMware"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) The name of the Morpheus provision type

### Read-Only
